Curriculum Flexibility: Design Your Own Learning Journey

At Anant, your education adapts to your curiosity, not the other way around. You have the freedom to mix and match from seven majors, eleven minors, and more than a hundred electives, shaping a path that feels truly your own.

Whether your interest lies in sustainability or storytelling, technology or textiles, you decide where your ideas lead you. You learn from global faculty and collaborators who encourage you to approach every challenge with creativity, ethics, and purpose.

Anant is a place where Indian roots meet global ideas. Every classroom becomes a space where students design solutions that bring us closer to the vision of a Viksit Bharat. Here, you don’t just earn a degree; you build your future, one project at a time.
Career-Oriented Education: Where Learning Meets Real Work

Learning at Anant is not confined to classrooms. It continues in studios, in industry collaborations, and in real-world projects. You get the chance to turn your ideas into action by working with leading recruiters such as Accenture, Piramal, Reliance, and TCS, or by building your own venture with the support of the Aarambh Incubation Centre.
For students seeking international exposure, many of our alums have continued their studies at prestigious universities such as Arizona State University and Nottingham Trent University.

The Career Services Office serves as your launchpad. Through workshops, mentorship, and live projects, you gain the skills and confidence to take the next step in your professional journey. With Aarambh, every aspiring entrepreneur receives personal guidance, from developing an idea to launching a product or a company.
Anant is rooted in India yet open to the world. It helps you turn what you love into the career you have always dreamed of.
World-Class Infrastructure: A Campus That Sparks Possibility

Anant’s seventy-eight-acre campus gives ideas the space to grow. Our studios, labs, and workshops are built to encourage experimentation and innovation. They are equipped with 3D printers, laser cutters, and robotic design tools, as well as everything you need to turn concepts into prototypes.

The campus is expanding, too. The upcoming one and a half lakh square metre addition is being designed by some of the most respected architects of our time, including B.V. Doshi, Rajeev Kathpalia, Bimal Patel, Rahul Mehrotra, Sasaki, Hafeez Contractor, Aniket Bhagwat, and Vijay Arya. This development will create a truly world-class environment for hands-on learning and collaboration.
Anant is more than a campus; it is a creative ecosystem. It is a place built to help you explore freely, design fearlessly, and reimagine the world around you.
